mathematics.assertion_tested: On the stored T1x x0.2562 shell spectrum, compare trapezoidal continuum sigma8 with bounded exact-integer-lattice top-hat weighting after replacing each mode power by its saved shell mean.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: IEEE-754 float64; integer lattice coordinates exact in int64; NumPy summation.
mathematics.conventions: L=100 Mpc/h, kf=2*pi/L; sigma8 radius=8 Mpc/h; original CFG650 shells [j-0.5,j+0.5)*kf; full signed lattice modes; exclude DC; sigma^2=sum P(k)W(8k)^2/L^3.
inputs: Exact copied T1x lean JSON x0.2562; saved shell mean k/P_grav and stored sigma8_grav
Source snapshots of CFG650 measure_pk and CFG805 trapezoid for estimator interpretation.
non_claims: Does not recover individual mode powers or exactly reproduce CFG650 stored sigma8.
Does not infer power below the finite-box fundamental.
Does not rerun or correct original lensing fits, K2, or class.

interpretation_rules.completed: Bounded numerical diagnostic only; inspect result before interpretation.
interpretation_rules.failed_or_timeout: No audit numerical conclusion; original source/scores unchanged.
interpretation_rules.distinguishing_result: Same-box discrete shell weighting removes most discrepancy; full cause still conditional on unavailable within-shell power distribution.
